children: Michael L. Baur, an insider reporting as a Director and serving as CEO, President, BOD Chair, sold Common Stock in multiple transactions on September 10–11, 2026 at weighted average prices reported per transaction. The reported weighted average prices ranged by transaction from $55.39, $57.03, $56.50, $57.71 and $58.14 per share. The total reported sale amount was $4,438,747. Following the reported transactions, Baur directly owned 200,698 shares of Common Stock.
